key_insight: DepthMaster aims to unify metric monocular depth estimation for both standard perspective images and 360° panoramic images in one model. The core breakthrough is handling the geometric differences between these camera types so depth predictions generalize across viewing setups.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of a single monocular depth estimation method that can reliably predict accurate metric depth for both narrow field-of-view perspective images and panoramic images. Existing methods are usually camera-specific and do not generalize well across these different projection geometries.
method: Designs a unified depth estimation framework that works across perspective and panoramic inputs.
Accounts for the geometric discrepancy between camera types to improve cross-domain depth prediction.
Targets metric depth estimation, not just relative depth, so outputs are more directly usable in real-world applications.
impact: This matters because practitioners often work with mixed camera data, such as phones, robots, AR/VR systems, and 360° sensors. A unified model can reduce the need for separate pipelines and improve deployment consistency across diverse visual environments.
